create_sync_vector_env: create a SyncVectorEnv instance from a list of rl_environment.Environment objects for synchronized batched RL
run_sync_vector_env_step: run one step on a SyncVectorEnv with step outputs and optional auto-reset when episodes end
test_sync_vector_env_reset: test the SyncVectorEnv reset method to reset specific or all environments and return time steps
review_sync_vector_env_observation_spec: review the SyncVectorEnv observation_spec method that returns the observation spec from the first environment
summarize_sync_vector_env_num_players: summarize the SyncVectorEnv num_players property that returns the number of players from the first environment
